events.text: Someone stole my card! There are charges on it I never made, about $650 in total.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you please provide me with the last 4 digits of your card and your email so I can verify this for you?
I don't know, I just need this fixed. Can you refund all of it right now?

I understand how concerning this is. To help resolve this, I need the last 4 digits of your card and your email to verify your account. Once verified, we can check the transactions and see how we can assist. Could you please provide that information?
